stem: The function \(f\) is linear, and \(f(x) + f(1 - x) = 10\) for all values of \(x\). If \(f(4) = 12\), what is the value of \(f(-3)\)?
solution: Let \(f(x) = mx + b\). Then \(f(x) + f(1 - x) = mx + b + m(1 - x) + b = m + 2b\).
So \(m + 2b = 10\). Also \(f(4) = 4m + b = 12\). Solving gives \(m = 2\) and \(b = 4\).
verify:
x, m, b = symbols('x m b')
f = lambda u: m*u + b
expr = expand(f(x) + f(1 - x) - 10)
eqs = Poly(expr, x).all_coeffs() + [f(4) - 12]
sol = solve(eqs, [m, b], dict=True)
assert sol == [{m: 2, b: 4}]
ans = f(-3).subs(sol[0])
assert ans == -2
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
